## Load packages

```{r setup}
pacman::p_load(here, limma, writexl)
here::i_am("02_Differential_Expression/01_Design/a_script/01_design.qmd")
```

## Read sample metadata

The sample table attached to the protein matrix is used, so the design follows its column order.

```{r read}
proteins <- readRDS(here("01_Preprocess", "02_Quantification", "c_data", "proteins.rds"))
targets <- proteins$targets

with(targets, table(treatment, timepoint))
```

## Design

Participant is a fixed effect because every contrast sits within one person (limma User's Guide
§9.4.2), which pairs the comparisons. The blood index from `02_Quantification` gives each protein a
slope on its sample's blood content, so blood no longer adds to the residual variance.

```{r design}
# makeContrasts() needs syntactic names, so the group prefix goes.
design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group + participant + blood, data = targets)
colnames(design) <- sub("^group", "", colnames(design))
rownames(design) <- targets$sample_id

stopifnot(
  is.fullrank(design),
  identical(make.names(colnames(design)), colnames(design))
)

c(
  samples = nrow(design), coefficients = ncol(design),
  residual_df = nrow(design) - ncol(design)
)
```

## Contrasts

The interaction is the study question; the baseline contrast checks counterbalancing, since legs
before training should differ by nothing.

```{r contrasts}
contrast_matrix <- makeContrasts(
  `BFR_Post-Pre` = BFR_T2 - BFR_T1,
  `HLRT_Post-Pre` = HLRT_T2 - HLRT_T1,
  `BFR_Pre-HLRT_Pre` = BFR_T1 - HLRT_T1,
  `BFR_Post-HLRT_Post` = BFR_T2 - HLRT_T2,
  Modality_x_Time_Interaction = (BFR_T2 - BFR_T1) - (HLRT_T2 - HLRT_T1),
  levels = design
)
contrast_matrix[rowSums(abs(contrast_matrix)) > 0, ]
```

| Name | Role | Compares | Reads as |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Modality_x_Time_Interaction` | primary | difference of the time effects | the study question |
| `BFR_Pre-HLRT_Pre` | baseline | two legs before training | baseline leg difference |
| `BFR_Post-Pre` | exploratory | one leg over time | what restricted training did |
| `HLRT_Post-Pre` | exploratory | the other leg over time | what conventional training did |
| `BFR_Post-HLRT_Post` | exploratory | two legs after training | leg difference at the end |

## Check within-leg correlation

Two samples from one leg may stay correlated after the participant term; while this estimate stays
near zero, `02_Differential` fits without a leg block.

```{r correlation-strata}
leg_id <- paste(targets$participant, targets$leg, sep = "_")

# Unweighted: the estimate ignores the standard errors the later fit uses.
round(duplicateCorrelation(proteins$E, design, block = leg_id)$consensus.correlation, 3)
```

## Save results

```{r write}
out <- here("02_Differential_Expression", "01_Design", "c_data")
saveRDS(
  list(design = design, contrasts = contrast_matrix, baseline = "BFR_Pre-HLRT_Pre"),
  file.path(out, "design.rds")
)
write_xlsx(
  list(
    samples = as.data.frame(targets),
    design = data.frame(sample_id = rownames(design), design, check.names = FALSE),
    contrasts = data.frame(
      coefficient = rownames(contrast_matrix), contrast_matrix, check.names = FALSE
    )
  ),
  file.path(out, "01_design.xlsx")
)
```
